Enum Class DrawCardEnum

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<DrawCardEnum>
it.polimi.ingsw.enumerations.DrawCardEnum
All Implemented Interfaces:
InteractiveEffectModifier, Serializable, Comparable<DrawCardEnum>, Constable
public enum DrawCardEnum extends Enum<DrawCardEnum> implements InteractiveEffectModifier
Represents the available card draw modes in the game.

Each constant defines whether a card is drawn from the upper or the lower list, and implements InteractiveEffectModifier to produce the corresponding Action, using the Strategy pattern.
